what: The always-current internal site: a reusable generator, in its own repository and consumed as a versioned Action, that turns this repository's own records and GitHub issues into a milestone depth chart, a phone triage view, and the records themselves
position: Eight milestones done through v1.5.1. M1-M4.1 built and rebuilt the planning page; M7 added a scaffold CLI; M8 made deployment stages real. M5 (register becomes data) is next, plan already written.
next: Write-back covers three things as of M8: a register answer, an acceptance result, a deployment-transition record. Nothing blocks M5. M6 needs a decision: reconcile with what M4.1 shipped, or supersede it.
